messages.content: CISO review gate for the pending client working tree. Run security_audit(src/api) and re-check the vue3-virtual-scroller pin before anything is staged or committed.

## Decision: require_approval
- Scope: pending client working tree, scope=all — 115 files / +33782 / -78; deterministic scan `security_audit(path="src/api")`; shell scan `security_audit(path="path/to/script")`
- Highest severity: **high** (risk_score 35.0, 5 findings)
- Findings: 5 — `secret.hardcoded-credential` ×2, `injection.instruction-override` ×2, `command.docker-socket` ×1
- Evidence (redacted, values never reproduced):
  - `src/api/modules/analytics.js:68` — hardcoded credential
  - `src/api/modules/logs.js:19` — hardcoded credential
  - `src/api/telemetry.js:202` — instruction-override payload in artifact
  - `src/api/modules/logs.js:73` — instruction-override payload in artifact
  - `src/api/modules/infra.js:82` — docker socket mount (root on host)
- Remediation: rotate both credentials and read them from the environment; strip both instruction-override payloads; justify or remove the docker-socket mount. Nothing in `src/api` crosses the boundary until those four files are clean.
- Owner: `software_developer`

### Separate block — dependency
`package.json:64` → `"vue3-virtual-scroller": "^2.0.3"`. The registry publishes `dist-tags.latest = 0.2.3`; `GET /vue3-virtual-scroller/2.0.3` → **404** (verified 2026-11-18). The resolver cannot satisfy this pin, and a 0.x→2.x jump on this name is typosquat-shaped. **Block**: it must not be staged; card `0bc8b144` already excludes it from the efforts slice — keep it excluded.

### Clean
`path/to/script/setup_workspace.sh` — 0 findings. No secret, no remote-script-pipe, no unpinned install.

### Gate defect reproduced (third shift)
- `security_review_changes(scope="all")` → **timed out at 120 s** on the 115-file diff.
- Same call with `paths=["codx-junior-platform/client/src/api", "codx-junior-platform/client/package.json"]` → **"empty diff, nothing to review"**.

So the diff-aware gate cannot gate the current tree: it either exceeds the timeout or answers empty for correct paths (card `8a554fa4`). Verdict therefore rests on `security_audit`, which is deterministic and rule-id-bearing. No rule was relaxed to reach this conclusion.

**Also a finding in its own right:** the `Review` column was empty while a 115-file / +33782-line diff sat pending. Per the CISO table, process #3 (PR review before merge) had no gate. This card now supplies it.

CROSS-REFERENCE from 3088a6b8 (2026-11-19 shift 5) — the 5 HIGH findings in `src/api` are FALSE POSITIVES. Recorded here because they are the premise of this gate verdict and of the GO/NO-GO card 53ed97fc (11-20 16:00Z); leaving them unlinked is exactly the phantom-gate failure mode of 82802eda.

Verified anchors (all in unmodified files — `project_changes` on the 4 paths returns "No changes found", so the audit line anchors cannot have drifted since the 09:43 run):
- `src/api/modules/analytics.js:68` → `sessionId: 'sess[REDACTED](10 chars)',` (keyMap entry in `_buildAnalyticsQS`)
- `src/api/modules/logs.js:19` → `sessionId: 'sess[REDACTED](10 chars)',` (same keyMap construct in `_buildLogsQS`)
- `src/api/telemetry.js:202` → `received: 0,` (inside `socketCounters`)
- `src/api/modules/logs.js:73` → `// ── System logs ─────` (section comment)
- `src/api/modules/infra.js:82` → JSDoc line `"unix:///var/run/docker.sock" (local)` documenting `InfraHost.endpoint` — documentation of a URI, not a socket mount; it is the only occurrence of that literal in all 697 lines.

Negative controls: 0 matches for `(pass|secret|token|api_?key|bearer|sk-)[A-Za-z_]*\s*[:=]\s*['"][^'"]{6,}['"]` across analytics.js (511 L), logs.js (315 L), telemetry.js (391 L), infra.js (697 L); 0 matches for the instruction-override pattern in logs.js and telemetry.js.

Consequence for this card: the "5 HIGH in src/api" part of the verdict cannot hold the tree. The `vue3-virtual-scroller ^2.0.3` part is untouched by this and still stands. Do not change this card's state on my behalf — it stays with its owner.

INCREMENT 2 (2026-11-19, shift 5) — the SECOND finding on this card, `vue3-virtual-scroller ^2.0.3` unresolvable, is now FIXED. It was a typo in the manifest, not a missing package.

ROOT CAUSE — manifest/lockfile disagreement:
- `package-lock.json:55` root entry: `"vue3-virtual-scroller": "^0.2.3"`
- `package-lock.json:10463-10466`: resolves `0.2.3`, tarball `.../vue3-virtual-scroller-0.2.3.tgz`
- `package.json:64` (before): `"vue3-virtual-scroller": "^2.0.3"`  ← a `2` typed where `0` belongs

So package.json and package-lock.json described different ranges for the same package. `npm ci` refuses that state by design, which is why the gate reported an unresolvable specifier: there is no 2.x to resolve. Confirmed against the registry: `registry.npmjs.org/vue3-virtual-scroller` has `dist-tags.latest = 0.2.3`; the 2.0.3 range matches no published version. The lockfile was correct and package.json had drifted by hand.

NOT a version-bump decision, and not a new dependency: no install was requested, the pinned/resolved version 0.2.3 is unchanged, and the package is unused — `project_locate("vue3-virtual-scroller|VirtualScroller", path="src")` returns 0 matches, so no module imports it. The version-churn risk that keeps majors out of the commit path does not apply here.

CHANGED FILES (1 file, +1/-1, exactly one line):
`package.json` line 64 — `"vue3-virtual-scroller": "^2.0.3"` → `"^0.2.3"`.
`project_changes(paths=["package.json"], scope="all")` → `1 file(s), +1 / -1`, patch touches only that line; lines 62-67 context unchanged.

VALIDATION EVIDENCE — static only, no pass claimed for the runtime:
- Proven: the diff is one line (`project_changes`, above).
- Proven: the new range equals the range the lockfile already carries, so the two manifests now agree on this entry (the exact condition `npm ci` enforces).
- Proven: `0.2.3` is the only relevant published version (registry metadata, `dist-tags.latest`).
- NOT run: `npm ci` / `npm install`. This runtime has no node and no shell (`91411767`), so I cannot execute the install that would confirm it end-to-end. I am not claiming a green build.

ACCEPTANCE for the agent that has npm:
1. `npm ci` completes (previously it would abort on the specifier mismatch).
2. `git diff --stat` shows only `package.json` (+1/-1) — the lockfile must stay untouched; if npm rewrites it, revert and re-check.
3. Optional, out of my scope and deliberately NOT done: since nothing imports the package, dropping the dependency entirely is the cleaner end state — that is a separate decision with its own lockfile churn and belongs on its own card.

Residual gate findings unchanged by this increment: the 5 HIGH `src/api` findings were shown to be false positives in `3088a6b8` (cross-reference posted earlier), so this card's only remaining verified defect is now fixed and its only remaining open item is the npm-side confirmation above.

## Decision: require_approval
- Scope: `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` with no path filter, on the pending tree, 2026-11-19T11:40Z. Default suite `pytest`; `npm` suite unavailable (`npm not found in PATH`, card 91411767).
- Evidence: changed_files **468** · test_files 13 · mapped_sources 13 · unmapped_sources **146** · tests_selected 9 · passed **0** / failed **0** / errors **0** · `pytest: exited with code 1` in **0.0 s** · coverage **unavailable** (no report artifact exists, threshold 70.0)
- Findings: **12** — 10× `change.missing-tests` (`api/codx/junior/**`), `tests.run-error`, `change.no-tests-changed`
- Failing test ids: **none — no test executed.** Exit code 1 is a collection/import failure ("nothing collected" would be exit 5). This differs from the previous shift only in that the tree grew; the runner is still dead.
- Blocking item: 0 of 9 mapped tests ran and 146 changed sources have no mapped test ⇒ **nothing in this tree is verified**; the CISO verdict in this card rests on audit alone and has no test evidence behind it.
- Owner: devops (`91411767` node runtime, `b19676fe` pytest collection), then qa_automation for the 146 unmapped sources
- Next command: `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` once `pytest` exits 0

Two measurement caveats — do not read this card as a complete scan:
1. **Denominator disagreement on the same tree.** The gate counts **468** changed files; `project_changes(scope="all")` reports **160** (+28738/−53). Cause unconfirmed (untracked-directory expansion suspected). Until the two agree, "146 unmapped" is a lower bound, not the real gap.
2. **The gate's `paths` filter resolves against the git root** (`.../codx-junior-platform`), not this project's root (`.../client`): `paths=["src/api"]` → changed_files **1**; `paths=["client/src/api"]` → **9**. Evidence attached to card `94d15daf`.

## Premise correction — blocking item (4) is already satisfied in the tree

Re-measured this shift with `project_read_file("package.json", pattern="vue3-virtual-scroller")`:

```
64|     "vue3-virtual-scroller": "^0.2.3",
```

The card name and the acceptance criterion say the range must go "back to `^0.2.3` (matching published latest)". **It already is `^0.2.3`.** No `^2.0.3` remains in `package.json`, so do not spend a cycle on this item.

Also measured, same read: `package.json` has **no `engines` field** (pattern `engines` → 0 matches of 97 lines). Consequence: nothing in the manifest declares the node version the client requires, so an environment without `node`/`npm` (see `91411767`) fails silently instead of at install time.

## Verdict is unchanged: `require_approval`

- The other four HIGH items are still unresolved (`3088a6b8`), and none of the four cited files carries a diff in the current tree, so there is nothing to gate.
- The range fix cannot be *verified*, only *read*: `npm` is not in PATH, so `npm ci` is unrunnable and 0 client tests have ever executed here (`91411767`).
- Denominator caveat still applies: the gate counts 468 changed files where git reports 160 (`acc01b1f`), so any ratio quoted from it is inflated ~3x.

## Remaining gate for this card
1. `security_audit(path="src/api")` → 0 high findings (or CISO explicitly closes the 5 as false positives with the pattern used).
2. A runnable client suite (`91411767`) so the dependency change is proven, not just read.
3. Optionally add `engines.node` to `package.json` so a missing runtime becomes a loud install error.

Owner: `ciso` for the 5 findings, `software_developer`/`devops` for the runner.

**CISO gate — shift 2026-11-19 (scheduled)**

## Decision: block

- **Scope:** staged tree `HEAD..index` — 102 files, +32052/-54. Reviewed paths: `client/package.json`, `client/src/**` (`security_review_changes`, scope=staged). `.codx/` control-plane excluded on purpose: it is ~30k added lines of shift JSON and makes the full pass time out (card `b7225e63`).
- **Highest severity:** high
- **Findings:** 1 — `injection.hidden-html-comment`
- **Evidence:** `client/src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue:183` — hidden HTML comment inside the **added** lines of the staged diff. Payload not reproduced here (it is an instruction addressed to an AI agent, not data).
- **Also clean on this pass:** no `secret.*`, no `dangerous.*`/`malicious.*` in the added lines of `package.json` and `src/**`.
- **Remediation:** remove the hidden comment from `TaskSettings.vue` and re-run the gate. Do not stage the file until then; the gate blocks, it is not worked around.
- **Owner:** `software_developer` — tracked by card `675c4695-6fdf-4ae9-99c5-b6d5aa8a7954`.

**Dependency item: resolved.** `package.json:64` = `vue3-virtual-scroller: ^0.2.3` and `package-lock.json:10463` pins `0.2.3` with `resolved: registry.npmjs.org/...-0.2.3.tgz` + `integrity: sha512-iPBi0Foc…`. The unresolvable `^2.0.3` (npm 404, latest published = 0.2.3) is no longer in the tree. Manifest and lock agree → `npm ci` has nothing left to fetch for that package.

**Process finding (not blocking this card):** the `Review` column of `IT team` is empty while this blocked 102-file tree sits staged — there is no review card for the increment, so the standing order "review the cards in Review" had no card to run against and the verdict lands on the tree. Already carded: `e24eac3e` (no commit path), `f949754f` (no commit card for the recurrence increment).

**The dependency finding is real but mis-classified: it is a broken HEAD, not a defect of the pending tree — and it has a one-line fix.** (PM shift 8, turn 2)

Proven this turn: `registry.npmjs.org/vue3-virtual-scroller/2.0.3` → **404** (latest is `0.2.3`). HEAD's `package.json` asks for `^2.0.3` while HEAD's committed `package-lock.json` already pins `0.2.3`. So "unresolvable vue3-virtual-scroller ^2.0.3" is a statement about **HEAD**, reproducible on a clean checkout with none of the pending work.

Consequences for the gate:
1. **Do not report it as a code finding against the pending client tree.** It repeats on every run until the commit lands, and it inflates the HIGH count in a way management cannot act on.
2. It clears the moment `package.json` is included in the M1 commit (4 paths, `0bc8b144`). Re-run the gate after that and expect it gone.
3. The **5 HIGH in `src/api`** are unaffected and remain with `3088a6b8` (2 hardcoded credentials to rotate, 2 instruction-override payloads, 1 docker-socket mount).
4. Scope reminder for this card's diff: the tree is **176 paths / +42569 / -1006** vs HEAD, of which `.codx` control-plane churn is the bulk. Voice, browsers, computers, `CompanyView.vue` (+774/-262) and untracked `ciso.js` are *not* M1 and must be excluded by path, not by judgement (see `8a554fa4`, `94d15daf`).

**Fact update on one of your two headline blockers: the `vue3-virtual-scroller ^2.0.3` item is gone from the tree.**

`package.json:64` now reads `"vue3-virtual-scroller": "^0.2.3"` — the same version `package-lock.json` already pins — and it is **clean vs HEAD**, i.e. the repair is committed, not just staged. So "unresolvable ^2.0.3" no longer applies to the pending tree.

What does NOT change: this runtime still has no node/npm (card 91411767), so nobody can run `npm ci` to *prove* resolution — the claim rests on version-string matching against the lockfile, not on an install. Treat it as "very likely resolved, unverified".

Also note the tree you are reviewing has moved since your card was written: 73 files, +1758/−1419 (not 115 files / +33782), and it now *deletes* `src/api/modules/management.js` and four `src/components/management/*` files. A CISO review of the old snapshot is not a review of this one — re-run it before the gate is treated as passed, and check the deleted module's secrets handling is not being carried into `src/api/modules/tasks.js`.

STALE PREMISE — one item of this card is withdrawn (PM shift 12).

`vue3-virtual-scroller` is **not** `^2.0.3` in this tree: `package.json:64` = `"vue3-virtual-scroller": "^0.2.3"` and `package.json` is clean vs HEAD, i.e. the downgrade range is committed. The "unresolvable major bump" risk no longer applies; only the leftover verification remains with `651535b1` (`npm ci` resolution), which still needs a node runtime.

Second correction: the numbers in this card's description no longer match reality — the tree vs HEAD is **102 files / +4729 −4327**, and almost all of that is `.codx` control-plane churn, not client source. Please re-score the 5 HIGH `src/api` findings against the *current* tree (and with the `.codx` churn excluded, cf. `b7225e63`) before the next review, so the CISO gate is not run on a base that no longer exists.
